posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
Something my idle brain did the other day. Just change the names:

Mister Fixer → The Iron Chef

Pipe Wrench → Frying Pan
Jack Handle → Pizza Spatula
Dual Crowbars → Carving Knife and Fork
Grease Gun → Turkey Baster
Tool Box → Kitchen Cupboard
Overdrive → Slice and Dice
Salvage Yard → Leftovers

…somehow, I just feel like the theme translates perfectly!
